events.what: very soft low tone wakes in the dark
a first sliver of light touches the burgundy edge
light band begins to travel across the back glass and logo (1.0-2.8 s)
bar 2: first chord (Dsus2); the phone is revealed
soft deep swell as the silhouette is revealed
light catches the camera lens rings
bar 2 beat 3: chord Bm11
camera glides back from the macro (2.0-3.4 s)
chord colour shifts towards the wake
phone turns from back towards its front (3.75-6.25 s)
display wakes with the Tree screen; piano motif A-D-F#-E
second half of the turn, front comes into view
hand-over to the display: the camera glides in (bar 4)
headline 1 appears: 'Your life, branch by branch.'
tap on the Travel branch: the camera flies into the tree
tap Open: branch page
tap a photo: viewer opens
tap Home: feed ('Share.')
tap Explore ('Discover.')
tap Playlists ('Collect.')
three devices, the camera pulls back (bar 10)
bar 11: everything falls away; chord Gadd9
chord Asus4: the question before the answer
bar 11 beat 3: logo lands; Dadd9 resolution
bar 12: slogan line, piano F#
film ends, everything has decayed

music.note: 12 bars x 2.5 s = 30.0 s exactly. Every scene change and the logo land on a beat.
music.structure: 96 BPM, bar = 2.5 s: hero 0-7.5 s (bars 1-3), app 7.5-25 s, brand 25-30 s; logo on bar 11 beat 3
